title: alnus mandschurica var. pubescens
intro: Alnus mandschurica var. pubescens, commonly known as Manchurian alder, is a deciduous shrub or small tree species native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used in Eastern medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Alnus mandschurica var. pubescens are attributed to its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce cholesterol levels, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
